R9–R12 · P50_has_current_keeper — independent of purchase events above
R6–R8 and R13 all concern the same aggregate object, Dunhuang Manuscripts. They record separate historical
events; the collection itself is never subdivided.
R9–R12 originate directly from Dunhuang Manuscripts. They are not a continuation of Stein's, Pelliot's or Ōtani's
purchases — no purchase event links to any keeper.
R14 links the aggregate manuscripts to the digitization process. R15 and R16 both terminate at the same Digital
Surrogate; only R16 is an Enriched relation.
